data.credibility: Management frequently guides aggressive expansion targets but frequently drops or leaves milestones unmentioned in subsequent quarters, making delivery tracking difficult. While food delivery outperformed targets, long-term margin and store rollout metrics lack consistent follow-through.

lines.line: Promised 2,100 Blinkit stores by Dec; dropped tracking with no actual reported.
Promised 3,000 Blinkit stores by March 2027; dropped tracking without actual figures.
Food delivery growth guided at 15% for FY26; actual achieved was 168.6%.
District losses expected to improve in FY27; dropped tracking entirely.
District breakeven guided in four to six quarters; dropped tracking.
Blinkit long-term margins guided to 5% to 6%; current actual is 3.0%, slipping.
Maintain Blinkit ROCE north of 40%; dropped tracking in subsequent quarters.
Quick commerce NOV growth guidance of 60% CAGR; currently on track.

bull: Consolidated revenue grew 169% YoY to INR 54,364 crore in FY26, with revenue compounding at 93.7% annually over five years.
Quick commerce dominates the revenue mix at 69.49%, driving rapid top-line expansion supported by a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.18.
Working-capital days tightened significantly from 96 to 23 over five years, alongside EBITDA margins turning positive at 2.2% in FY26.
bear: Valuation remains extremely steep with a TTM P/E ratio of 712.0 against a modest net profit of INR 493 crore.
Return metrics are very low with an ROE of 0.94% and an overall ROCE of 2.48% on consolidated operations.
Blinkit margins are currently at 3.0%, falling short of the guided 5% to 6% long-term target range.
